• t: true, it means this donor is a teacher

commonsense evidence:

• t: true, optional support (tip) was included for DonorsChoose.org

commonsense evidence:

• t: true, a portion of a donation used account credits redemption

columns.description: payment included campaign gift card. whether a portion of a donation included corporate sponsored gift card

commonsense evidence:

• t: true, a portion of a donation included corporate sponsored gift card

columns.description: payment included web purchased gift card. whether a portion of a donation included citizen purchased gift card (ex: friend buy a gift card for you)

columns.description: payment was promo matched. whether a donation was matched 1-1 with corporate funds
columns.value_description:
commonsense evidence:
• f: false, a donation was not matched 1-1 with corporate funds
• t: true, a donation was matched 1-1 with corporate funds

columns.name: via_giving_page
columns.description: via giving page. donation given via a giving / campaign page (example: Mustaches for Kids)

columns.name: for_honoree
columns.description: for honoree. donation made for an honoree
columns.value_description:
commonsense evidence:
• f: false, this donation is not made for an honoree
• t: true, this donation is made for an honoree
